title: Gaussian-beam-propagation theory for nonlinear optics involving an analytical treatment of orbital-angular-momentum transfer

scope.reason: Reusable propagation method; not a complete PSR quantum-noise theory.

sources.title_in_source: Gaussian Beam-Propagation Theory for Nonlinear Optics - Featuring an Exact Treatment of Orbital Angular Momentum Transfer

findings.claim: The Green-function mode expansion uses a first-order Born approximation and a weakly modified pump.
findings.locator: PDF p. 2, Sec. II.A, Eqs. (2)-(3); p. 7, conclusion
findings.model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ A candidate spatial propagation layer must retain its perturbative limit.

findings.claim: The developed propagation treatment is classical and uses an idealized lossless, dispersionless medium.
findings.model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not use this alone as a Langevin covariance or strong-absorption model.
